mn52:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando vesāliyaṃ viharati veḷuvagāmake.
mn52:1.3: tena kho pana samayena dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro pātaliputtaṃ anuppatto hoti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
mn52:2.1: atha kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro yena kukkuṭārāmo yena aññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
mn52:2.2: kahaṃ nu kho bhante āyasmā ānando etarahi viharati
mn52:2.4: eso gahapati āyasmā ānando vesāliyaṃ viharati veḷuvagāmaketi.
mn52:3.1: atha kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro pātaliputte taṃ karaṇīyaṃ tīretvā yena vesālī yena veḷuvagāmako yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
mn52:3.2: atthi nu kho bhante ānanda tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo akkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttañceva cittaṃ vimuccati apparikkhīṇā ca āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti ananuppattañca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātīti.
mn52:3.3: atthi kho gahapati tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo akkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttañceva cittaṃ vimuccati apparikkhīṇā ca āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti ananuppattañca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātīti.
mn52:3.4: katamo pana bhante ānanda tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo akkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttañceva cittaṃ vimuccati apparikkhīṇā ca āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti ananuppattañca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātīti.
mn52:4.1: idha gahapati bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn52:4.3: idampi kho paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ
mn52:4.4: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhammanti pajānāti
mn52:4.5: so tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti
mn52:4.6: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā
mn52:4.7: ayampi kho gahapati tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo akkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttañceva cittaṃ vimuccati apparikkhīṇā ca āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti ananuppattañca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti.
mn52:5.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn52:5.3: idampi kho dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ …pe…
mn52:6.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn52:6.3: idampi kho tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ …pe…
mn52:7.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn52:7.3: idampi kho catutthaṃ jhānaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ …pe…
mn52:8.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbatthatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahagagtena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati
mn52:8.3: ayampi kho mettā cetovimutti abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā
mn52:8.4: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhammanti pajānāti
mn52:9.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu karuṇāsahagatena cetasā …pe…
mn52:11.1: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbatthatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati
mn52:11.3: ayampi kho upekkhā cetovimutti abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā
mn52:11.4: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhammanti pajānāti
mn52:12.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn52:12.4: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhammanti pajānāti
mn52:13.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn52:13.4: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhammanti pajānāti
mn52:14.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn52:14.4: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhammanti pajānāti
mn52:14.5: so tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti
mn52:14.6: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā
mn52:14.7: ayaṃ kho gahapati tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo akkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttañceva cittaṃ vimuccati apparikkhīṇā ca āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti ananuppattañca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātīti.
mn52:15.1: evaṃ vutte dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
mn52:15.2: seyyathāpi bhante ānanda puriso ekaṃ nidhimukhaṃ gavesanto sakideva ekādasa nidhimukhāni adhigaccheyya
mn52:15.3: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante ekaṃ amatadvāraṃ gavesanto sakideva ekādasa amatadvārāni alatthaṃ savanāya
mn52:15.4: seyyathāpi bhante purisassa agāraṃ ekādasadvāraṃ so tasmiṃ agāre āditte ekamekenapi dvārena sakkuṇeyya attānaṃ sotthiṃ kātuṃ
mn52:15.5: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante imesaṃ ekādasannaṃ amatadvārānaṃ ekamekenapi amatadvārena sakkhissāmi attānaṃ sotthiṃ kātuṃ
mn52:15.6: ime hi nāma bhante aññatitthiyā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesissanti kimaṅgaṃ panāhaṃ āyasmato ānandassa pūjaṃ na karissāmīti.
mn52:16.1: atha kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro pātaliputtakañca vesālikañca bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātetvā paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi
mn52:16.2: ekamekañca bhikkhuṃ paccekaṃ dussayugena acchādesi āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ ticīvarena acchādesi āyasmato ānandassa pañcasataṃ vihāraṃ kārāpesīti.
